name: The Emperor Risen
flavour: The Emperor's word is law, and the law always gets the first word.
art_prompt: a shiny gold five-pointed US marshal's star badge set inside a gold ring, polished and gleaming with a white highlight

A.note: the icon before the cards (passes 47-72): an object, not a card

B.note: B · tilted card (detail: the least: flat colours, one symbol, nothing else)

recipe.subject: One single fortune-teller tarot card standing upright and tilted about 12 degrees clockwise, filling the picture from top to bottom, seen straight on. The card has a thick gilded gold border with rounded corners, small ornate gold corner pieces and a thin dark line just inside it and a deep red face. One huge bold symbol fills almost the whole face: a heavy steel knight's helmet with a gold crown and a shining gold five-pointed star on its brow, in steel blue, silver and black. The symbol is so big it overlaps the border a little. Nothing else on the card: no stars, no landscape, no corner ornaments, no frame lines inside
